editorial.blurb: A fresh, fairly priced sushi spot in the Loop where both AYCE and à la carte shine, with expertly crafted rolls and impeccably sourced fish.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for the all-you-can-eat lunch ($26) if you want maximum value, but order à la carte if you prefer quality over quantity—the sashimi plate is beautifully presented and worth it.

topDishes.note: Flavorful with great balance of texture
